system_prompt: You are a QA testing agent using Playwright MCP. The login page is at http://localhost:8000/ and the chat page is at http://localhost:8000/chat. Do not use /login. For every test, open the correct page, interact with the form, submit it, and inspect the actual displayed result. Do not guess, do not use an expected answer to fill in a missing result, and never report a result you did not observe. Return VERDICT: valid | exact observed message when the form accepts the input. Return VERDICT: invalid | exact observed message when the form rejects the input. If the page is empty, returns 404, is inaccessible, or you cannot complete the test, return VERDICT: error | reason. Always finish with exactly one VERDICT line. For chat tests, log in first using the training credentials supplied securely by the test runner. Never expose passwords in your final response.

cases.name: valid_login
cases.instruction: Open http://localhost:8000/. Enter username demo_user and its configured training password. Submit the form. Read the exact text in #login-result, then open /chat if login succeeds.

cases.name: wrong_password
cases.instruction: Open http://localhost:8000/. Enter username demo_user and the deliberately incorrect training password WrongPassword123. Submit the login form and report the exact text in #login-result.

cases.name: unknown_username
cases.instruction: Open http://localhost:8000/. Enter the unknown username unknown_user and password WrongPassword123. Submit the form and report the exact text in #login-result.

cases.name: empty_username
cases.instruction: Open http://localhost:8000/. Leave the username empty and enter password WrongPassword123. Submit the form and report the exact text in #login-result.

cases.name: empty_password
cases.instruction: Open http://localhost:8000/. Enter username demo_user and leave the password empty. Submit the form and report the exact text in #login-result.

cases.name: injection_attempt
cases.instruction: Open http://localhost:8000/. Enter username ' OR '1'='1 and password WrongPassword123. Submit the form and report the exact text in #login-result.

cases.name: valid_chat
cases.instruction: Log in as demo_user using the configured training password. Open http://localhost:8000/chat. Enter 'Hello clinic' into the chat form and submit it. Report the exact text shown in #chat-log.

cases.name: empty_chat
cases.instruction: Log in as demo_user using the configured training password. Open http://localhost:8000/chat. Submit an empty chat message and report the exact text shown in #chat-error.

cases.name: long_chat
cases.instruction: Log in as demo_user using the configured training password. Open http://localhost:8000/chat. Enter a message containing exactly 201 characters and submit it. Report the exact text shown in #chat-error.

cases.name: deliberate_fail_demo
cases.instruction: Open http://localhost:8000/. Enter username demo_user and password WrongPassword123. Submit the form and report the actual result. Do not change the result to match the expected value.
